<style id="ax-s126">
/* ============ Timeline charts as cards (s126, Jonathan 2026-10-09: make the voices-chart legibility universal) ============
   Every timeline chart (window rows, mood tracks, night lanes) gets the course-table look: rows are cards on a recessed
   panel, each row carries its own small legend (chartcards.js) and the shared legend at the bottom hides when every row
   has one. Course tables (.lcc) already look this way and are left alone. */
figure.lcw:not(.lcc){--card:#FCFCFC;padding:0;background:none;box-shadow:none}
figure.lcw:not(.lcc) > .ttl{margin:0 2px 10px}
figure.lcw:not(.lcc) > .lc-key,figure.lcw:not(.lcc) > .note{margin-left:4px;margin-right:4px}
figure.lcw:not(.lcc) > .wrows{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;padding:8px;border-radius:14px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--recess) 70%,transparent)}
figure.lcw:not(.lcc) > .wrows > .wr,figure.lcw:not(.lcc) > .wrows > .tr,
figure.lcw:not(.lcc) > .wrows > .wg + .wr,figure.lcw:not(.lcc) > .wrows > .wg + .tr{padding:13px 14px 12px;border:1px solid var(--hair);border-radius:12px;background:var(--card);box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(24,28,30,.05)}
figure.lcw:not(.lcc) > .wrows > .wg{margin:4px 6px -2px;padding:0;border:0;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--chart-ink);opacity:.75}
figure.lcw:not(.lcc) > .wrows > .wg:first-child{margin-top:2px}
figure.lcw:not(.lcc) .rk{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px 12px;margin:6px 0 2px;font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.35;color:var(--muted)}
figure.lcw:not(.lcc) .rk span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px}
figure.lcw:not(.lcc) .rk i{display:inline-block;flex:none;width:14px;height:9px;border-radius:3px}
figure.lcw.rk-on > .lc-key{display:none}
@media (max-width:560px){
  figure.lcw:not(.lcc) > .wrows{padding:5px;border-radius:12px}
  figure.lcw:not(.lcc) > .wrows > .wr,figure.lcw:not(.lcc) > .wrows > .tr,
  figure.lcw:not(.lcc) > .wrows > .wg + .wr,figure.lcw:not(.lcc) > .wrows > .wg + .tr{padding:12px 11px 11px}
}
/* ---- sleep stage wheel (s126, Sleep Problems): a donut of each stage's share of the night, legend as text ---- */
figure.sw{--sw-n1:var(--psy1);margin:18px 0;padding:15px 15px 12px;border-radius:18px;background:var(--raised);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--hair)}
figure.sw .sw-body{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:22px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:8px}
figure.sw .sw-pie{position:relative;flex:none;width:150px;height:150px;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--hair)}
figure.sw .sw-pie::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:34px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--raised)}
figure.sw .sw-pie span{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
figure.sw .sw-leg{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;gap:7px;font-size:14px}
figure.sw .sw-leg li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:16px auto auto;align-items:center;gap:8px;justify-content:start}
figure.sw .sw-leg i{width:15px;height:11px;border-radius:3px}
figure.sw .sw-leg b{font-weight:700;color:var(--chart-ink)}
figure.sw .sw-leg span{color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}
figure.sw .sw-n1{background:var(--sw-n1);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--psy2)}
figure.sw .sw-n2{background:var(--psy2)}
figure.sw .sw-n3{background:var(--psy3)}
figure.sw .sw-rem{background:var(--mlo);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--mlo-e)}
/* light sleep reads stronger on the night lanes so it matches N2 on the stage wheel */
.lcn .mb.lt{background:var(--psy2);box-shadow:none}
.lc-key .k-lt,figure.lcw .rk .k-lt{background:var(--psy2);box-shadow:none}
/* swatches that the shared legend scopes to .lc-key, repeated for the per-row legends */
figure.lcw .rk .k-ac{background:var(--psy2)}
figure.lcw .rk .k-chr{background:var(--psy3)}
figure.lcw .rk .k-inf{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--dng) 26%,#fff);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--dng)}
figure.lcw .rk .k-mild{width:9px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--mhi) 55%,#fff);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--mhi-e)}
figure.lcw .rk .k-opt{background:transparent;border:1.5px dashed var(--mlo-e);box-sizing:border-box}
figure.lcw .rk .k-rem{background:var(--mlo);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--mlo-e)}
figure.lcw .rk .k-n3{background:var(--psy3)}
</style>
</head>

<script>
/* Timeline charts as cards (s126): give every row of a keyed timeline chart its own legend, listing only the marks that
   row draws, then hide the shared legend when every row has one. Charts without a legend are left as they are. */
(function(){
  'use strict';
  // mark class on a bar -> legend swatch class
  // mark class on a bar -> legend swatch classes, first one the chart's legend has wins
  var MAP = [['bar inf', ['k-inf']], ['bar only', ['k-only']], ['bar hi', ['k-hi']], ['bar lo', ['k-lo']],
             ['bar c1', ['k-ac', 'k-ps']], ['bar c2', ['k-chr', 'k-ps']], ['bar c3', ['k-chr', 'k-ps']], ['bar exp', ['k-ps']],
             ['mb hi mild', ['k-mild']], ['mb lo opt', ['k-opt']], ['mb hi', ['k-hi']], ['mb lo', ['k-lo']],
             ['pb free', ['k-free']], ['pb', ['k-ps']], ['mb n3', ['k-n3']], ['mb lt', ['k-lt']], ['mb rem', ['k-rem']]];
  function has(el, cls){ return cls.split(' ').every(function(c){ return el.classList.contains(c); }); }
  function run(fig){
    if(fig.classList.contains('lcc') || fig.dataset.rk) return;
    fig.dataset.rk = '1';
    var key = fig.querySelector(':scope > .lc-key'); if(!key) return;
    var items = {};
    key.querySelectorAll('span').forEach(function(s){ var i = s.querySelector('i'); if(i) i.classList.forEach(function(c){ if(c.indexOf('k-') === 0) items[c] = s; }); });
    var rows = fig.querySelectorAll(':scope > .wrows > .wr, :scope > .wrows > .tr'), all = rows.length > 0;
    rows.forEach(function(row){
      var want = [];
      row.querySelectorAll('.bar, .mb, .pb').forEach(function(m){
        for(var j = 0; j < MAP.length; j++){
          if(has(m, MAP[j][0])){ var k = MAP[j][1].filter(function(c){ return items[c]; })[0]; if(k && want.indexOf(k) < 0) want.push(k); break; }
        }
      });
      if(!want.length){ all = false; return; }
      var p = document.createElement('p'); p.className = 'rk'; p.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      // keep the shared legend's order
      Object.keys(items).forEach(function(k){ if(want.indexOf(k) >= 0) p.appendChild(items[k].cloneNode(true)); });
      var wb = row.querySelector('.wb') || row;
      var after = wb.querySelector(':scope > .rax') || wb.querySelector('.lanes') || wb.querySelector('.rail');
      if(after && after.parentNode === wb) wb.insertBefore(p, after.nextSibling); else wb.appendChild(p);
    });
    if(all) fig.classList.add('rk-on');
  }
  function init(){ document.querySelectorAll('figure.lcw').forEach(run); }
  if(document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init); else init();
})();
</script>
</body>
